data.title: Amazon launches new Bee 'personal AI' devices that listen to conversations
data.description: The $75 Bee Frontier is an upgraded version of Amazon's wearable bracelet, while the $100 Bee Eclipse attaches to a user's smartphone.
data.author: Annie Palmer
